text:
I generated 50 ad videos before coffee this morning.

Total bill: $5.50.

Not each. All 50.

Seedance 2.0 on @itsPolloAI prompt in, finished e-commerce spot out, $0.11 a video.

Here's the part that should make you angry:

/ Higgsfield: $2.25/video → those 50 = $112;
/ OpenArt: $1.40/video → those 50 = $70; 
/ the "premium" tools you defend: $1.50–2.50 → up to $125 
/ Pollo: $0.11/video → $5.50

You're not paying for better video. You're paying for worse math.

And the price isn't even the real unlock. 

This is:

/ you stop pitching one "hero" idea and test 40 
/ you stop protecting weak takes because they "cost something" 
/ you stop waiting on an agency to schedule what you ship before lunch 
/ your competitor still thinks 50 videos is a budget meeting

At $2.50 a render you ration. At 11 cents you saturate. Saturation is what wins the feed now.

Nobody lost the AI-content game on talent this year. 

They lost it on a pricing page they never bothered to open.
